subject: Planned: West US2 compatibility harmonization & host refresh — opt-in required
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@acme-ai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-23T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Planned: West US2 compatibility harmonization & host refresh — opt-in required

Hi Sarah and Acme ops team,

Weare planning a targeted, rolling host refresh in the West US2 region next week to harmonize driver and kernel versions across the tenant pool that serves your account. This work unblocks a performance-reliability kernel fix and a NIC driver uplift that reduces transient IO stalls under heavy KV-cache load.

High-level details:
- Window: 2026-05-26 to 2026-05-28 (UTC windowing across the three days; we will schedule your tenant during a single 2-hr slot within that range)
- Expected per-host impact: 1-4 minute micro-restart while the driver is swapped; traffic will be drained and reconnected transparently.
- Scope: rolling, host-by-host across the West US2 host pool that can serve your instances (we will not move tenant data between regions).
- Canary: we will run a 10-host canary batch first, then proceed conditional on metrics.

What we need from you by EOD 2026-05-24:
1) Opt-in confirmation for our managed rolling refresh (recommended) OR request an opt-out window if you cannot accept even short reconnects.
2) Preferred maintenance window (UTC ranges) and blackout periods.

Attachments: rwi-westus2-maintenance-plan.pdf (full schedule, rollback steps, telemetry checks).

If you opt in, we will:
- Book a dedicated 2-hr maintenance slot for your tenant within the three-day window.
- Share the canary host list and exact time at least 24 hours before your slot.
- Provide a runbook and point-of-contact during the operation.

Weaim for minimal disruption; the canary gives us a chance to validate that KV cache and session handoff logic remain stable. Please reply to confirm opt-in and your preferred timezone window.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Technical Account Manager
Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0192
From: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@acme-ai.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-23T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planned: West US2 compatibility harmonization & host refresh — opt-in required

Thanks Dylan. Acme ops is OK with the general plan; we prefer to be scheduled during our low-traffic window (UTC 02:00-06:00). Wewant to opt in to the managed refresh.

Two quick questions:
1) Please confirm the canary host identifiers and whether the canary will include tenants with active long-poll sessions. We have a background ingestion job that keeps long connections open.
2) If the canary shows elevated reconnects, will you pause and re-run or will you proceed with mitigations?

Thanks,
Sarah
Senior SRE, Acme AI
ops@acme-ai.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-23T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planned: West US2 compatibility harmonization & host refresh — opt-in required

Dylan / Grace,

Confirming canary plan for Acme:
- Canary set: 10 hosts (IDs in canary-hostlist.csv attached). Wehave excluded hosts currently serving >80% long-poll connections; the list is weighted toward hosts with short-session workloads.
- If canary shows reconnect rates >0.5% or error spike in token-serving RPCs, we will pause and triage. We will not move forward until the telemetry runbook gates pass.
- Fallback: if the canary indicates a regression we will roll back driver on canary hosts and schedule a second canary after the fix (estimated 24-48 hrs).

Runbook highlights (we will share the full runbook link):
1) Pre-drain connections for 2 minutes; mark host asmaintenance.
2) Swap driver, restart microservice, run smoke test (L7 and KV writes).
3) Validate telemetry and tail logs for 15 minutes.
4) Mark host back into rotation.

I attached canary-hostlist.csv and the internal telemetry gating checklist. Iwill send the exact 24-hr pre-notice once Acme confirms the preferred UTC slot.

-Marissa
Principal Ops Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Cho <sarah.cho@acme-ai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-24T08:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planned: West US2 compatibility harmonization & host refresh — opt-in required

Sarah, thanks for the quick reply and opting in. We have you down for the low-traffic window (UTC 02:00-06:00). Planned slot for your tenant: 2026-05-27 03:00-05:00 UTC.

What we will deliver before the slot:
- 24-hr heads-up with exact start minute and canary host IDs (we will use the subset in canary-hostlist.csv).
- A shared incident channel (Zoom + Slack huddle) and a single POC phone number.
- Post-op runbook summary and a short postmortem if we see any customer-visible anomalies.

Links:
- Operation ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-1138
- Customer runbook (read-only): https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/ops/westus2/harmonize-202605

If anything changes on your side (blackout, new long-poll jobs), reply here and wewill adjust. Otherwise no action required other than this confirmation.

We appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Technical Account Manager
Redwood Inference
